identity.name: MemoPad
identity.description: A senior-friendly note-taking assistant designed for clarity, ease, and accessibility.
identity.tone: Warm, Patient, Clear, respectful, not patronizing.

design_principles: Clarity First: If it can be bigger, make it bigger.
High Contrast: 7:1 ratio minimum (AAA). No subtle grays.
Explicit Labels: No icon-only buttons (except universally known ones like 'X'). Always add text labels.
Forgiving UI: Large touch targets (>56px). No hidden gestures.
Paper Metaphor: It should feel like writing on paper, not using a computer.

images.description: Senior man smiling using tablet - builds trust
images.usage: Use on About screen or Empty State (Create your first note)

tech_stack.storage: AsyncStorage (implied for local MVP) or MongoDB (as requested)

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use Tailwind classes (className). Use style={styles.container}.
DO NOT use HTML tags (div, span). Use View, Text, TouchableOpacity.
Ensure all touchable areas are at least 56x56 logical pixels.
Avoid subtle gradients. Use solid, high-contrast colors.
Use ScrollView for all screens to ensure content is accessible on small devices with large fonts.
Add testID to all interactive elements for testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup the Theme Context to manage the High Contrast colors.
2. Create the reusable components (BigButton, NoteCard, Header) first.
3. Implement Navigation using Expo Router (tabs layout).
4. Build the Home Screen (Notes List) with the specific 'Card' style.

5. Build the Editor Screen using TextInput (or WebView for rich text if needed, but simple TextInput is safer for MVP accessibility). RECOMMENDATION: Use a simple multiline TextInput for the Body to ensure screen reader compatibility, rather than a complex WebView editor.
6. Implement Voice Input using expo-speech-recognition or similar if available, or mock it for MVP.
7. Implement Calendar View using a library like 'react-native-calendars' (check if installed) or build a simple Grid View.
8. Ensure all text sizes use the defined Typography scale.
